name: St. Clair County, AL
findings: St. Clair County has 151 nonprofit organizations. 48 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, St. Clair County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in St. Clair County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 53% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 50% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
